name_zh: 皮耶特/瑞士/银行/保密/数字/金融/苏黎世/日内瓦/财富
description_zh: 皮耶特家族（始于1541），瑞士银行家族，苏黎世/日内瓦银行世家，银行保密原则创始人，现代银行制度奠基者，家族银行长期经营，倡导保密和客户利益，其银行保密原则和家族银行模式对国际金融产生深远影响。
description_en: Pictet family (started 1541), Swiss banking family, Zurich/Geneva banking dynasty, founder of banking confidentiality principle, established modern banking system, family banking long-term operation, advocated confidentiality and client interests, its banking confidentiality principle and family banking model profoundly influenced international finance.
reason_zh: 皮耶特家族是瑞士银行的象征，其银行保密原则和家族银行模式对国际金融产生深远影响，家族银行的长期经营和保密原则成为国际金融的经典范例。
reason_en: Pictet family is symbol of Swiss banking, its banking confidentiality principle and family banking model profoundly influenced international finance, family banking's long-term operation and confidentiality principle became classic example of international finance.
expected_zh: 建立瑞士银行保密原则，家族银行长期经营，其银行保密原则和家族银行模式对国际金融产生深远影响。
expected_en: Established Swiss banking confidentiality principle, family banking long-term operation, its banking confidentiality principle and family banking model profoundly influenced international finance.
